keyVerseDR: "Come after me, and I will make you to become fishers of men." (Mk 1:17)

level1.title: Follow Me!
level1.story: Jesus said, "The Kingdom of God is near!" He saw Simon and Andrew fishing. He said, "Come, follow Me!" and they followed Him right away.
level1.heartIntro: Draw inside the heart, then color it!
level1.prayer: Jesus, I will follow You. Amen.

activity.title: Fishermen sudoku
activity.intro: Each row and column has each picture once.

level2.title: Fishers of Men
level2.story: After John was arrested, Jesus came into Galilee preaching the gospel of God. He said, "The time is accomplished, and the kingdom of God is at hand: repent, and believe the gospel." Passing by the sea, He saw Simon and Andrew casting nets. Jesus said, "Come after Me, and I will make you to become fishers of men," and they left their nets and followed Him. He also called James and John, who left their father Zebedee in the boat.
level2.keyLine: I will make you to become fishers of men.
level2.heartIntro: Write 3 ways you can do each, then color the border!
questions: Why did they follow right away?
What might Jesus be calling you to?
level2.prayer: Jesus, help me follow You right away. Amen.

activity.title: Fix the words
activity.intro: Three words are wrong. Cross them out and write the right ones.
activity.text: Come after Me; and I will make you to become {farmers|fishers} of {fish|men}. And {later|immediately} leaving their nets, they followed Him.
